s.note: Christmas Eve on the streets of New York
s.how: Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread with 200g cream cheese, top with 150g smoked salmon, capers and thin red onion and serve on a board.

s.note: the hunt for the Nutcracka Ball
s.how: Bake 1.2kg chicken wings at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter into 100ml hot sauce and toss the wings through. Serve with 150ml ranch and celery sticks.

m.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and cook with cheese slices. Serve in slider buns with pickles. Bake 250g macaroni in a cheese sauce of 200g tasty cheese and 400ml milk in muffin tins at 190C for 15 minutes.

w.note: the end of the night with the three friends
w.how: Melt 125g butter with 150g golden syrup and 100g brown sugar. Mix in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 egg and 150ml milk. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes and ice with 150g icing sugar and lemon juice.

d.note: a cold New York Christmas Eve
d.how: Heat 750ml red wine with orange slices, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 3 tbsp sugar for 15 minutes without boiling. Ladle into mugs and have sparkling apple juice ready for anyone not drinking.
